description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller class 'HelloController' which provides several endpoints including a welcome message, redirect to API docs, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for the notes application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health status, and app info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message as a string.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds a redirect URL to Swagger UI and redirects the client, preserving original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating application health.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a string with application information.
